Video demos

Source: vignettes/articles/videos.Rmd
videos.Rmd

Each demo runs about 90 seconds and has English captions. Every number on screen comes from a real run of the package. To watch on YouTube, use the links under each video.

Workbench tour

From a data file to a report without writing code: Load the SAT12 example, explore it, let the workbench compare the Rasch, 2PL and 3PL models, read the plain-language results, open the Wright map and an item health card, and download the report and the R script.

Watch on YouTube · Workbench guide · New to R

AI Hub

A machine scorer that agrees with human raters overall, and the check that shows it scores English language learners too low. Then near-duplicate items and difficulty prediction from item text.

Watch on YouTube · AI Hub

From select_model() to an APA Methods paragraph, a reference list and a Word file with cite_methods().
